title: CRAFT: Constrained Route planning with Adaptive Framework and Template-based code generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25128v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Everyday routing requests are rarely a point-to-point shortest path. A driver may need to visit stops, sometimes in a fixed order, under time budgets or distance limits, and perhaps recharge their EV car along the way. Each combination is a distinct routing problem that classically requires its own algorithm, so no fixed solver covers the space of queries users may ask. This paper presents CRAFT, which takes a constrained routing query as free text and returns a route that satisfies the user's requirements on a real road network. An LLM parses the query and generates four search functions, which a generic graph-search engine executes on the road network. We formalize the underlying problem as State-Expanded RCSP (SE-RCSP), which extends resource-constrained shortest paths (RCSP) with non-additive state such as node-dependent resets and discrete progress tracking. We evaluate CRAFT on 2,600 natural-language queries over California road

translated_title: CRAFT：基于自适应框架与模板化代码生成的约束路径规划
translated_abstract: 日常的路径规划请求很少是简单的点到点最短路径问题。驾驶员可能需要途经多个停靠点，有时需按固定顺序访问，同时受时间预算或距离限制的约束，甚至可能需要沿途为电动汽车充电。每一种约束组合都是一个独特的路径规划问题，传统上需要各自专门的算法来解决，因此没有固定的求解器能够覆盖用户可能提出的所有查询类型。本文提出了CRAFT，它接收以自由文本形式表达的约束路径规划查询，并在真实路网上返回满足用户需求的路线。大语言模型（LLM）解析该查询并生成四个搜索函数，由通用的图搜索引擎在路网上执行。我们将该底层问题形式化为状态扩展资源受限最短路径问题（SE-RCSP），它在传统的资源受限最短路径（RCSP）基础上扩展了非加性状态，例如依赖于节点的重置和离散进度跟踪。我们在加州路网上使用2,600个自然语言查询对CRAFT进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出CRAFT框架，利用大语言模型将自由文本形式的约束路径规划查询解析并转化为可执行的搜索函数，同时将底层问题形式化为SE-RCSP，从而在真实路网上生成满足固定顺序访问、时间/距离限制及电动车充电等复杂约束的可行路线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CRAFT, a framework that uses LLMs to parse free-text constrained routing queries and generate search functions executed by a generic graph-search engine, formalizing the problem as State-Expanded RCSP (SE-RCSP) to produce routes satisfying complex user constraints on real road networks.
